name: Confirmed Directional Credit Spread (Strategy 2)
note: Export of the rules. Source of truth is the code: final_spread_strategy.py, research_directional_spreads.py (signal_table, make_legs_fn), research_positional.py (run_cycle), cost_model.py. If you change a value here, change it in code too.
instrument: NIFTY 50 weekly options, nearest weekly expiry

schedule.entry: 09:30 IST on the first trading session after each weekly expiry
schedule.exit: 15:15 IST on expiry day (never held into settlement)

fii_options.source: NSE participant-wise OI file (fao_participant_oi_DDMMYYYY.csv) published the evening BEFORE entry day
fii_options.formula: x_t = (FII opt_idx_CE_long - FII opt_idx_CE_short) - (FII opt_idx_PE_long - FII opt_idx_PE_short); raw = x_t - x_{t-1}; signal = raw - median(raw of all PAST entry weeks, min 20 weeks)

opening_gap.formula: spot(09:30 on entry day) / close(previous session) - 1

signals.rule: Trade ONLY when both signals have the same sign; otherwise skip the week.

structure.straddle_S: ATM CE + ATM PE price at 09:30 (ATM = spot rounded to nearest 50)
structure.bullish: SELL PE at ATM - d, BUY PE at ATM - d - 200  (bull put spread)
structure.bearish: SELL CE at ATM + d, BUY CE at ATM + d + 200 (bear call spread)
structure.stop_loss: none (risk defined by the long leg)

sizing.rule: lots = max(1, floor(0.08 * equity / (200 * 65)))  -> a full max-loss week costs <= ~8% of equity
sizing.recommended_change: v2 (2026-10-01): skip if credit/(200-credit) < 0.232 (credit < ~38 pts); bear calls full size, bull puts half size -> 11.4% CAGR, -8.4% max DD, Sharpe 2.31 (v1: 12.4%, -19.1%, 1.46). VIX and squeeze filters tested and rejected. See docs/STRATEGY_2_TRADE_ANALYSIS.md

backtest_assumptions.fills: 1-minute close; sell at close - slip, buy at close + slip
backtest_assumptions.slippage_points: 0.3 + 0.5% of premium per fill (stops: 0.5 + 1.5%, unused here)
backtest_assumptions.charges: cost_model.option_fill_cost: brokerage Rs20/order, STT on sells 0.05%->0.0625%(Apr-23)->0.1%(Oct-24)->0.15%(Apr-26), NSE txn 0.0503%->0.03503%(Oct-24), SEBI Rs10/cr, stamp 0.003% buys, GST 18%
